summary.text: Arthur Burks is an independent candidate for Wisconsin's 4th District. According to his campaign website, as described by WUWM, he has been rooted in Milwaukee since the 1970s and has run several businesses there. He is running on living wages, local business investment, gun safety legislation and housing access.

paragraphs.text: According to his campaign website, as reported by WUWM, Burks has run many successful businesses in Milwaukee and raised a family in the city.
The website says he has been active in the National Action Network, though WUWM reports that the organization would not confirm his membership or participation.
Burks did not answer WUWM's candidate questionnaire and has not completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey.
He qualified for the November 2026 ballot as an independent.
